# agentic-campaign

Plan a social campaign calendar across brands and platforms.

Keywords: campaign,calendar,planning,agentic-suite,cli,mcp.

- SDK: import { summarizeText, dispatchText } from "agentic-campaign".
- CLI: agentic-campaign summary --text "...".
- MCP: run agentic-campaign mcp, then call summarize_text.

## Docs
